english.title: Use a passenger vehicle with tyres with insufficient tread - less than 1.6mm
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) used on a road, namely **(..SPECIFY ROAD AND LOCATION..), a small passenger vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), constructed or adapted to carry no more than eight seated passengers in addition to the driver, when the grooves of the tread pattern of a tyre fitted to the **(..SPECIFY WHEEL LOCATION..) wheel of the vehicle were not of a depth of at least 1.6mm throughout a continuous band comprising the central three-quarters of the breadth of tread and round the entire outer circumference of the tyre
english.legislation: Contrary to regulation 27(4) of the Road Vehicles (Construction and Use) Regulations 1986, section 41A of the Road Traffic Act 1988 and Schedule 2 to the Road Traffic Offenders Act 1988.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
use on a road a small passenger vehicle
constructed/adapted to carry no more than eight seated passengers
in addition to the driver/goods vehicle
when the grooves of the tread pattern of a tyre
fitted to the wheel of the vehicle was not of a depth of at least 1.6mm.

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) For vehicles which require a minimum tread depth of 1mm (i.e. larger goods and passenger vehicles) see offence wordings: H154, H158 and H160.
(ii) This offence wording does not apply to motor cycles
(iii) Use this offence wording for motor cars.
(iv) See also offence wordings: H150 and H151.
(v) See also H422, H423 and H424 in relation to goods vehicles.
(vi) See also H425, H426 and H427 in relation to light trailers.
(vii) Fixed penalty scheme may be applied
english.standardstatementoffacts: At **(..SPECIFY TIME..) on **(..SPECIFY DATE..) the defendant used **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..) which was a small passenger vehicle constructed to carry no more than eight seated passengers plus the driver on **(..SPECIFY ROAD AND LOCATION..). The grooves in the tread pattern of the tyre fitted to the **(..SPECIFY WHEEL..) wheel of the vehicle were less than 1.6 mm deep throughout a continuous band situated in the central three-quarters of the breadth of tread and round the entire outer circumference of the tyre.

welsh.welshoffencetitle: Defnyddio cerbyd bychan i gludo teithwyr gyda theiar heb wadn digonol - llai na 1.6mm
welsh.welshstandardoffencewording: Ar **(..SPECIFY DATE..) yn **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) bu i chi ddefnyddio ar ffordd, sef **(..SPECIFY ROAD AND LOCATION..), gerbyd bychan ar gyfer teithwyr, sef **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), wedi'i adeiladu neu ei addasu i gludo dim mwy nag wyth teithiwr yn eistedd ynghyd â'r gyrrwr, pan nad oedd rhychau patrwm gwadn teiar a oedd wedi'i ffitio i olwyn **(..SPECIFY WHEEL LOCATION..) y cerbyd o leiaf 1.6mm o ddyfnder mewn band di-dor yn cynnwys tri chwarter canol lled y gwadn ac o gwmpas holl gylchedd allanol y teiar
welsh.welshstandardstatementoffacts: Ar **(..SPECIFY DATE..) am **(..SPECIFY TIME..) defnyddiodd y diffynnydd **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..) sef cerbyd bychan ar gyfer teithwyr a oedd wedi'i adeiladu i gludo dim mwy nag wyth teithiwr yn eistedd ynghyd â'r gyrrwr ar **(..SPECIFY ROAD AND LOCATION..). Roedd y rhychau ym mhatrwm gwadn y teiar a oedd wedi'i ffitio i olwyn **(..SPECIFY WHEEL..) y cerbyd yn llai na 1.6mm o ddyfnder mewn band di-dor yn nhri chwarter canol lled y gwadn ac o gwmpas holl gylchyn allanol y teiar.
welsh.welshlegislation: Yn groes i reoliad 27,(4)(d) ac (f) Rheoliadau Cerbydau Ffyrdd (Gwneuthuriad a Defnydd) 1986, Adran 41A Deddf Traffig Ffyrdd 1988 ac Atodlen 2 Deddf Troseddwyr Traffig Ffyrdd 1988.

other.penalty:
A fine not exceeding level five on the standard scale.

Obligatory endorsement - licence endorsed three penalty points.

Discretionary disqualification.

Fixed penalty ticket - one hundred pounds and licence endorsed three penalty points.

Time limit for prosecutions:
6 months

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates’ court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
